result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and gave the expected answers. I checked H2, H5 and H10 by hand.

- **Rounding:** qlang has no `round` verb. H2 and H10 round by adding 0.5, then keeping the part of the printed number before the ".", then dividing back.
- **`--raw`:** H8 to H11 read text files, so run them with `qlang --raw '<query>' < file`.
- **Map output:** `--raw` prints map keys in qlang form (`:auth`), not JSON form (`"auth"`).

H1: filter ~(if (at :active | eq true) ~(if (at :country | upper | eq "DE") ~(if (at :age | type | eq ::number) ~(/age | gte 30) ~(false)) ~(false)) ~(false)) * /name | sort
H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * (/items * (mul /qty /price)) | flat | sum | mul 100 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 100
H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower) * count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys * keyword | sort)}
H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /id]) | take 3 * /id
H6: * (coalesce ~(/labels) ~([])) | flat * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count
H8: lines * split " " | filter ~(count | gt 2) | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
H9: lines * split " " | filter ~(count | gt 2) | filter ~(/1 | if (eq "ERROR") ~(true) ~(eq "WARN")) * (filter ~(startsWith "user=")) | flat * (split "=" | /1) | distinct | sort
H10: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(count | gt 4) | filter ~(/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter ~(/2 | eq "" | not) | groupBy ~(/1) * (:n (count) | * (/2 | parseJson) | sum | div n | mul 10 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parseJson | div 10)
H11: lines | filter ~(split "=" | /0 | upper | startsWith "DB_") | groupBy ~(split "=" | /0 | split "" | drop 3 | join "" | lower) * (first | split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d)) :team (coalesce ~(/owner/team) ~("none"))} | sort ~(/name)
H13: /results | filter ~(if (at :score | type | eq ::number) ~(/score | gte 50) ~(false)) | sort ~(/score) | reverse * (:p / | /profile/first | append " " | append (p | /profile/last) | append ": " | append (p | coalesce ~(/tags) ~([]) | join "|"))
H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split "" * (if (gte "a") ~(if (lte "z") ~(/) ~(" ")) ~(" ")) | join "" | split " " | filter ~(split "" | count | gt 0) | :ws / | distinct * (:x / | {:word x :count (ws | filter ~(eq x) | count)}) | sort ~([(/count | mul -1) /word]) | take 3
